card.name: Just before chemotherapy drug names in regimens
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before a chemotherapy drug is named, such as 'intrathe-cal' or 'intravenous' before methotrexate, or a comma in a drug combination list. Mostly cancer regimens in oncology labels.

modes.label: Route before methotrexate
modes.description: Route words like intrathecal or intravenous that come right before methotrexate.
